outcome: Live before/after measurement of the deprecated DeviceEntry.config_entries removal on the household installation. Median server save evaluation fell from 5.53 s to 1.62 s, median save response from 7.30 s to 3.18 s, and the per-minute reconcile cycle's event-loop block from 4.6 to 5.5 s to about 0.8 s. The catalog reload after an edit is unchanged at about 1.8 s and is now the largest remaining share of a Stop Monitoring action.
